description: Defines the MyEmailsDashlet class for the SuiteCRM email dashboard, including constructor, process, and displayScript methods.

classes.name: MyEmailsDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for displaying user emails in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with configuration data and sets default title, search fields, columns, and seed bean.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes email data for display, applying filters for unread inbound emails and joining email text.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript for quick create menu with links to related modules.
